title: console shows internal representations to users: composite / record-map field values as raw JSON on the record page, and the Audit Log Browser actor as a raw user id
body:
Filing gate: ① user-visible UX defect — `reach:` record page and Setup → Audit Log Browser, measured; separate card under the maintainer's quota exception (provenance below).
Reader: objectui triage first-touch → `domain:ui` lane (`packages/fields`, `apps/console`); may split into two PRs.
Dedup (semantic search, open + closed, objectui): "record detail shows raw JSON for composite object field, audit log browser actor shows raw user id instead of name" → 7 hits, all closed; objectui#4037 fixed the same class for `address`, objectui#10112 for user columns in RelatedList; neither covers these two surfaces.

Environment: framework `ce577ec4` showcase booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on its own port and SQLite file; console = objectui `f9f4a62d` (`apps/console` Vite dev server, and a production `vite build` for timings); Chromium 141 headless, 1440×900, seeded admin.

## Repro

1. Showcase → Data Model → Field Zoo → "Specimen — Full". Actual: "Composite (embedded object)" renders `{"width":10,"height":20}` and "Record (name-keyed map)" renders `{"primary":{"name":"A","score":…` truncated — raw JSON in a monospace face.
2. Setup → Diagnostics → Audit Log Browser. Actual: the Actor column shows a truncated user id (`D5HVjHiXQRsZLSYMO…`) and the filter asks for "Actor (user id)". The object list of the same rows (Setup → Audit Logs) shows the user's name ("Dev Admin").

## Where

- `packages/fields/src/widgets/ObjectField.tsx` — the read face renders `JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)` (likely the path for composite / record values; the exact display branch was not instrumented).
- `apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx` — the Actor cell renders `truncate(r.user_id, 18)`; the actor filter is a free-text user id.

## Expected

Structured values render as labelled key/value rows (the composite's declared sub-fields); the audit actor renders the user's display name (id on hover), and the actor filter picks a user rather than taking a typed id.

Provenance: filed as a separate card on the maintainer's explicit instruction in the dispatching session, which lifts the per-fire filing quota for this batch of seven, verbatim — 「重新思考以上和用户体验相关的问题，哪些需要立卡」 then 「分开立 7 张」. Found during a browser dogfood sweep of the console; companion checklist card objectstack-ai/objectui#11672. Filed by session `session_01WEARdKfDHDT7rTuEhLyT1k`.
